newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish EMU changeover plan due for release Apr 16.
newsitem.headline: Finnish EMU changeover plan due for release Apr 16.

text.p: Finland will publish on April 16 its national plan of measures to be taken to prepare for membership of the third stage of economic and monetary union, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.

The so called EMU changeover plan will be updated every six months, Rauno Niinimaki, head of the ministry's EMU project, told a news conference. He declined to give details of the contents of the report.
Of the EU's 15 member countries only the Netherlands and Belgium have so far published their own national changeover plans, he said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
